supported: A deterministic baseline-phase correction agrees with the paired-reference result in this narrow Stage2 setup.

not_supported: Clutter cancellation or recovery of multichannel clutter coherence under clutter-present conditions.
Operational blind estimation, production CUDA performance, Pd/Pfa, tracking benefit, or a need for AI.
